source_basis: purpose-built scenarios; not derived from operational records

cases.scenario: A fictional scenario omits a non-required descriptive value.
cases.expected_handling: Show the value as unavailable; do not invent a replacement.

cases.scenario: A fictional work-in-progress scenario has not yet supplied all expected evidence.
cases.expected_handling: Make incompleteness visible; do not represent the scenario as finalized.

cases.scenario: Two fictional candidate values disagree for the same descriptive attribute.
cases.expected_handling: Surface the conflict for authorized human review; do not select or normalize either value.

cases.scenario: A fictional future planning item is included for a projected period.
cases.expected_handling: Label it as projected; do not represent it as a completed assessment, signature, or event.

cases.scenario: Fictional input examples use different labels for a comparable concept.
cases.expected_handling: Preserve the candidates and flag mapping for review; do not treat any label as an approved canonical term.
